あらすじ

Main character loses after an accident two years ago. Life goes on peacefully till he notices a shadow of a woman with a gun followed by receiving an injection. All his senses improve immensely, but so do his desires. Standing in a pool of blood he hears her say: “Finally your powers have been unsealed”.
